rationale: Blind and edge-case lenses raised 9 concerns total; all 9 were independently verified against the codebase and found to be pre-existing, documented, already-accepted architectural trade-offs that this diff faithfully mirrors (the identical success-join pattern already shipped in production for invocations_hourly, including its documented cross-midnight dirty-marking gap in .ai-run/guides/integration/cli-analytics-storage.md's 'Known limitations' table) rather than new defects introduced by this change — none are blocking. The one genuine open item is the acceptance lens's 'partial' on the Jira ticket's AC5 ('Automated tests cover successful, rejected, and failed Write/Edit operations'): the new tests are SQL-string/substring assertions and a binary files_changed-threshold check, not scenarios that execute three distinct successful/rejected/failed fixtures. This matches the testing approach the user already approved in spec.md ('SQL-string assertions are therefore the established ceiling' — no live-Postgres test harness exists anywhere in this repo), but it is still a literal partial against the raw ticket wording, so it is surfaced here rather than silently waved through. 3 non-blocking observations deferred (see below); 0 dismissed.

business_review.notes: rollups.py span branch requires e.success='true'; hook-fallback requires e.ended (agent.tool.end), before setting is_written.

business_review.notes: Same success/e.ended gating applied symmetrically to is_edited; files_edited FILTER unchanged in reader.py.

business_review.item: Failed/rejected modifications do not increment Files Changed
business_review.notes: reader.py: count(*) FILTER (WHERE written OR edited) AS files_changed, combined with upstream success-gated is_written/is_edited.

business_review.item: Only successfully applied modifications affect Dead/Wasted classification
business_review.notes: _dead_sessions() keys off files_changed (now success-gated end-to-end); new tests directly confirm files_changed==0 -> dead/wasted and files_changed==1 -> not dead.

Matches the approved spec's explicit testing-ceiling statement, but is a literal partial against the raw ticket AC wording.

business_review.notes: Exact FILTER expression applied verbatim in reader.py, matching the identical pattern already used elsewhere in rollups.py (~line 1010).

business_review.notes: All three tests added exactly as specified.

Diff touches only internal SQL aggregation logic over existing span/hook-event data; no auth, secret, or new untrusted-input surface.

findings.problem: The Jira ticket's acceptance criterion 'Automated tests cover successful, rejected, and failed Write/Edit operations' is only partially met: the new tests assert SQL text/substrings and a binary files_changed threshold, not three distinct successful/rejected/failed fixtures exercised end-to-end.
findings.impact: If the success-gating logic has a subtle bug the SQL-string assertions don't catch (e.g. a typo'd value or an inverted condition that still contains the right substrings), no test would fail — real behavioral proof is deferred.
findings.recommendation: Accept as-is (matches the approved spec's explicit 'SQL-string assertions are the established ceiling' statement, consistent with 100% of this repo's existing tests for this exact code area, and no live-Postgres harness exists anywhere in the repo to do better without a separate infra investment), or decide a live-DB test harness should be built as follow-up work — this is a scope/investment judgment call, not a code defect to patch inline.

deferred_non_blocking: Blind lens: span-branch LATERAL join has no session_id scoping (only tool_use_id) — verified to exactly mirror the pre-existing, production invocations_hourly pattern, which the file's own comment documents as intentional ('any session: the join is on tool_use_id alone').

Blind + edge-case lenses: the success-join's [-1h,+1d] window and the dirty-marking cross-midnight reach mismatch (1h mark vs 1-day join reach) can leave is_written/is_edited stuck false until a full rebuild — verified as an already-documented 'Known limitation' in .ai-run/guides/integration/cli-analytics-storage.md ('The span path has the same gap'), shared identically by the pre-existing invocations_hourly logic; not newly introduced.

Blind lens: rows with empty tool_use_id can never be marked written/edited post-fix — verified to match the identical ON tool_use_id <> '' guard already used by invocations_hourly; low-probability given tool_use_id is fundamental to the tool-call protocol.
